trustBoundary.supported: Only names and observable values listed in this manifest are compatibility commitments.
trustBoundary.unsupportedPrivate: Private authority, concrete Go/database/provider objects, locks, channels, process handles, and unlisted fields are not plugin API.
trustBoundary.externalEffects: Filesystem, network, email, timers, and adapter calls can have external or uncertain effects; they are not replay-safe.

realmRules: A callback and its host values belong to the runtime generation and realm that created them.
Synchronous realm entry is used outside a callback; notification scheduling is used from inside a realm callback.
Values must not be retained across runtime generations or passed between runtime realms.

callbacks.notes: The order is a pipeline ordering contract; branch-specific callbacks only run when their event or command state applies.

mutationWhitelistCandidates.note: Candidates require request-local DTOs and typed mutation checks; authoritative pointers are never exposed.

unsupported_compatibility.name: seal.vars.write.$m
unsupported_compatibility.reason: global player attributes have no event-sourced owner in this compatibility generation; reject rather than misroute

unsupported_compatibility.name: seal.vars.write.$g
unsupported_compatibility.reason: group attributes have no event-sourced owner in this compatibility generation; reject rather than misroute

unsupported_private.name: seal.inst
unsupported_private.reason: dangerous reflective authority; only an explicit opt-in escape hatch, not part of this contract

unsupported_private.name: provider-runtime-objects
unsupported_private.reason: concrete adapter/provider state is not a JS contract

external_effect_ambiguous.name: fs
external_effect_ambiguous.reason: filesystem reads and writes are external effects and can be uncertain across crashes

external_effect_ambiguous.name: fetch-and-network
external_effect_ambiguous.reason: network calls are external effects and are not replay-safe

external_effect_ambiguous.name: seal.adapter.call
external_effect_ambiguous.reason: immediate provider calls retain invocation ownership, are not automatically retried, and cannot be rolled back with the callback transaction

external_effect_ambiguous.name: seal.adapter.enqueue
external_effect_ambiguous.reason: callback submissions commit atomically into the encrypted outbox; dispatched unknown actions are non-idempotent and may settle as ambiguous

external_effect_ambiguous.name: send-and-notice
external_effect_ambiguous.reason: adapter delivery is asynchronous and may be best-effort or externally ambiguous

external_effect_ambiguous.name: registerTask
external_effect_ambiguous.reason: timers execute outside the callback transaction and can outlive a generation
